design_purpose.patch_m: Connected nine metre tongues of growth follow irregular old damage, not concentric planted rings.
design_purpose.outer_radius_gain: Blend recovery into ordinary biome cover outside the native impact margin.
design_purpose.quiet_density: Leave the eroded channels and broken host visible between grown tongues.
design_purpose.grown_density: Dense low growth in recovered pockets, still subject to full support and protected footprints.
design_purpose.debris_share: Sparse settled chips tie exposed host into the grass without adding harvestable stock.
design_purpose.ground_mix: Blend loam and the existing authored turf/litter into the same recovery mask on original supported tops only.
design_purpose.fragment_clearance_m: Extra sixteen centimetres beyond each actual transformed fragment footprint.
design_purpose.woodland_mat_share: Share of eligible woodland recovery roots using the low broadleaf mat instead of upright grass/ferns.
design_purpose.mat_footprint_m: Moving radius includes the authored 0.315 metre leaves and their small wind travel.
design_purpose.chip_footprint_m: Support clearance includes the fitted 0.40 metre settled chips.
design_purpose.inner_radius_gain: The inner margin retains full recovery influence before blending into the ordinary biome.
design_purpose.eligible_weight: Ignore imperceptible outer-mask tails for recovered rock planting and old scree replacement.
